full_description: watch the hole board and press each mole from above when it pops up; two moles bob at randomized rates; touched moles turn green; with distractors do not touch rabbits (they turn red and fail); with relocating moles each mole may reappear from a free hole after going down; Opt 1 and Opt 2 can combine

preference: num of words should not exceed 14. Degree of detail avg is 6
